prompt: Set up an Infisical Secret Rotation for our production PostgreSQL application user, rotating every 30 days. Show me the API request body and tell me exactly what I need to prepare in the database beforehand.
assertions: Requires TWO pre-existing database users via username1/username2
States both users must already exist and Infisical does not create them
Maps both username and password via secretsMapping
Warns the application must read the username from Infisical too, since the active user alternates
grading: deterministic regex; negative assertions ignore counter-example lines
